node.title: Re: Win32::PowerPoint Extension for Lines and Shapes (updated)
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
This works for me:

use Win32::OLE::Const; # may need to adjust version number depending on what you have installed my $const = Win32::OLE::Const->Load('Microsoft Office 12.0 Object Library'); ...->AddShape($const->{msoShapeRectangle}, ...);

Update:

how to change the color of the line that I can successfully draw

[https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/office/vba/api/powerpoint.shapes.addline|MSDN says]: "[AddLine] Returns a [https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/office/vba/api/powerpoint.shape|Shape] object that represents the new line." and clicking through that a bit (plus stealing sub RGB from [mod://Win32::OLE::TPJ]) gives this, which works for me:

sub RGB { $_[0] | ($_[1] >> 8) | ($_[2] >> 16) } my $shape = $slide->Shapes->AddLine(100,200,300,400); $shape->{Line}{ForeColor}{RGB} = RGB(255,0,0);
